name: Quantum Many-Body Theory
summary: Field-theoretic methods for interacting electrons and bosons in solids and quantum fluids.

topics.name: Second quantization for fermions and bosons
Hartree-Fock theory and the homogeneous electron gas
Feynman diagrams at zero and finite temperature
Linear response, the dielectric function and screening
Collective excitations: plasmons, phonons and magnons
Interacting bosons: superfluidity and Bogoliubov theory
The Hubbard model and strong correlations (introduction)
Numerical many-body methods: exact diagonalization, quantum Monte Carlo, DMRG
